info:
## Garden Lights Telegram Integration

**Flow Number:** 321

### Purpose
Provides Telegram bot commands for garden lights control.

### Commands
- `/lights_on` - Turn all lights ON
- `/lights_off` - Turn all lights OFF
- `/lights_status` - Get status of all 16 lights
- `/lights_help` - Show help for lights commands

### Features
- Master ON/OFF control for all lights
- Comprehensive status display (16 lights)
- Interactive inline keyboard
- Command logging with request IDs
- Integration with shared telegram_bot_config

### Dependencies
- telegram_bot_config (shared)
- mqtt_broker_local
- garden_lights_state (flow context)

### Integration
Commands are routed from main Telegram interface (50-telegram-interface.json).
